test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Do you want / to visit a zoo / when you / go to Ahmedabad?
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"to visit a zoo."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment** 'to visit a zoo' **is incorrect.
 
• The error lies in the use of the article** "a"** before the noun** "zoo."**
 
• Here, we are referring to the specific **"zoo,"** so must use **"the" **before the word **"zoo."**
 
• The correct sentence would be *"Do you want **to visit the zoo**__ when you go to Ahmedabad?"*
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
